subject: Request: trial runway extension for DevDelta — integration delay
messages:
From: Samir Bose <samir@devdelta.com>
To: Olgа Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah@devdelta.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial extension request — integration delay

Hi Olga,

Quick note from our engineering team — we hit an unexpected blocker with the SAML adapter (third-party dependency) that has pushed our connector work out by ~2–3 weeks. We had planned to finish integration this week and ramp our evaluation traffic, but the delay means we won't be able to exercise the trial window as intended.

Can we request a short runway extension (3 weeks) and a modest sandbox top-up so we can finish end-to-end testing once the adapter is stable? We don't need production capacity yet — just additional sandbox tokens to complete the validation run and a bit more time on the trial.

I've attached the integration roadmap and a short log excerpt that shows the failure path. Happy to jump on a quick call with Ben or your SE to walk through details.

Attachments:
- integration-roadmap.pdf (PDF)
- poc-log-snippet.txt (text)

Thanks,
Samir Bose
Lead Engineer, DevDelta
samir@devdelta.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Bose <samir@devdelta.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration delay

Thanks for the context, Samir — sorry to hear about the SAML hiccup. I appreciate the attachment; that log helps.

Looping in Ben (AE) and Naomi (SE) to proposal an extension and token top-up. Ben — can you advise what runway and credit level we can offer for a case like this? Naomi, would you be able to spare 30–60 minutes with Samir this week to triage the SAML failure and help scope the remaining validation?

-Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Bose <samir@devdelta.com>, Leah Park <leah@devdelta.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration delay

Hi Samir / Leah — thanks for flagging this and for the diagnostic artifacts. Appreciate you sharing the roadmap.

We can do a runway extension and a sandbox token allocation on a case-by-case basis; for engineering blockers caused by third-party adapters we typically offer up to 3 weeks plus a token top-up. For DevDelta I propose: 3 additional weeks on the trial window and 250k sandbox tokens to finish end-to-end validation.

Markus (cc'd) — requesting approvals for the extension + token bump against deal DD-7234. If approved we will record the adjustment in HubSpot and issue a sandbox credit grant.

If that plan works for you Samir, let me know and Naomi and I will schedule a short troubleshooting session (30–45 min) to accelerate the fix.

Next steps suggested:
- Markus to approve extension & token top-up
- Ben to update HubSpot and trigger sandbox grant
- Naomi + Samir to triage SAML session this week

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration delay

Approve: 3-week extension + 300k sandbox tokens.

Notes/conditions:
- Please log the credit as a conditional sandbox grant on deal DD-7234 in HubSpot (link below).
- Require brief follow-up call between Naomi and Samir this week to confirm reproduction & remediation steps before tokens are released.
- Security/SSO checklist must be started (we need confirmation SAML metadata will not change mid-eval).

Ben — please update HubSpot and attach the integration-roadmap.pdf to the deal record. Once Naomi confirms the reproduction we’ll issue the token grant and extend the trial window by 21 days from the current trial expiry.

Thanks — approving on the condition we have the SE sign-off.

-Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Samir Bose <samir@devdelta.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah@devdelta.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — integration delay

Ben / Olga / Markus — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the approval. 3 weeks + 300k tokens will be huge for us. Naomi — available Thursday 10:00–11:00 PT for the troubleshooting call, I can share a screen and walk through the SAML flow.

I've re-attached the cropped log with timestamps that show the assertion failure (poc-log-snippet.txt). We will start the SSO checklist tonight and share metadata updates if anything changes.

Thanks again — we’ll treat this as high priority and aim to have remediation validated within the window.

Best,
Samir
Lead Engineer, DevDelta
